title: Road Textures
og_description: Download this package (90 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!
visual_summary: Modular top-down road and sidewalk tile set with two clear lanes of art. The upper portion shows dark asphalt road segments on green grass: roundabouts of two sizes, four-way and three-way intersections, T-junctions, dead-ends, straight runs, gentle curves, crossings, and small connector nubs. The lower portion shows light blue pedestrian and pavement tiles including straight sidewalks, corners, T-junctions, crossings, round plazas, and sandy-beige dirt patches. All tiles are 64x64, flat-shaded, crisp-edged, and clearly designed to snap together on a grid for procedural or hand-built city maps.
